blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Beth&f: This is so strange... 
&e[NPC] Beth&f: I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: WHAT? There are &banimals &finside of here?!?! &cJake &fis doing &chorrible experiments &fwith these &banimals &fthat he catches...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!
&e[NPC] Beth&f: And look at all of these tools he has laying around here... a SAW?... a HAMMER? 
&e[NPC] Beth&f: What is this psycho doing with these &banimals&f???
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &cJake &fhas a lot of explaining to do!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: ... BETH?? AND &&<capitalized player name>&f, WHAT ARE YOU GUYS DOING IN HERE???
&e[NPC] Jake&f: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!

&e[NPC] Beth&f: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE &bANIMALS&f!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &bANIMALS&f? I CAN EXPLAIN, I SWEAR!

&e[NPC] Beth&f: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my &2workshop&f!
&e[NPC] Jake&f: I am just making &btoys &ffor &banimals&f...

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: We know that you are experimenting with &banimals &fdown here, how do you explain this tank?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: Those are my &bplushies&f! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!
&e[NPC] Jake&f: They look super realistic, but no &banimal &fwas harmed when making them!
&e[NPC] Jake&f: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the &bplushies &fI made, you can have it!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: So really, I am not harming them at all!

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &7<player>&f, thank you so much for telling me what you saw here. I'll be forever grateful.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: That was a close one, thank you &7<player> &ffor having my back. Anyway, I need to go back to my business.
}}

{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You've now attended &61&f meeting of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Attend two more and I'll give you my &3Abiphone Contact&f.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, where did we finish off last time?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The master plan.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Right, the master plan. &5Thondin&f, care to update us?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: My wife said we can have a sleepover if you promise not to break anything this time.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Break anything? It wasn't me, it was &5Brarnas&f! And, honestly, who stores plates like that anyways?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: They're just asking to be knocked over. Why not just put them in a drawer, out of the way?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You don't need to display them. Everyone has plates, they're nothing special.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: You said you never even saw the plates.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And I didn't! But &5Brarnas&f told me about it.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: No I didn't.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Anyways!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: My wife said I'm free to come to the sleepover if I do the dishes first.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Try not to break those too.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Cool.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I was thinking of hosting it on the fifteenth?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: I don't think that would work.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Yeah, it doesn't really align with our cult's theme. How about the fourteenth instead?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Sure.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: I'm not really available then, couple coworkers are off so the boss wants me in to cover.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Well, you should probably make yourself available.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Jobs may come and go, but the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f is eternal.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: You are right. I shall be there.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Awesome.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, next point of interest...
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hold up, guys. My wife's calling.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hello? Mhm? Okay. Calm down. Yes, I'll come and look, make sure you check under the porch.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Cat again?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Cat again. I've got to go.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, I guess we can end the meeting there. Same time next week!}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] Beth&f: This is so strange... 
&e[NPC] Beth&f: I can't believe this has been down here for all this time... I am speechless.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: WHAT? There are &banimals &finside of here?!?! &cJake &fis doing &chorrible experiments &fwith these &banimals &fthat he catches...
&e[NPC] Beth&f: He has gone completely mad! He's a psychopath!
&e[NPC] Beth&f: And look at all of these tools he has laying around here... a SAW?... a HAMMER? 
&e[NPC] Beth&f: What is this psycho doing with these &banimals&f???
&e[NPC] Beth&f: &cJake &fhas a lot of explaining to do!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: ... BETH?? AND &&<capitalized player name>&f, WHAT ARE YOU GUYS DOING IN HERE???
&e[NPC] Jake&f: IT'S NOT WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE!

&e[NPC] Beth&f: WE KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING IN HERE, YOU PSYCHO! YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU ARE DOING TO THESE &bANIMALS&f!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: &bANIMALS&f? I CAN EXPLAIN, I SWEAR!

&e[NPC] Beth&f: WELL GO ON THEN, EXPLAIN YOURSELF!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: I don't know what you guys think I am doing here, but this is just my &2workshop&f!
&e[NPC] Jake&f: I am just making &btoys &ffor &banimals&f...

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Oh really? Do you really think we are that naive?
&e[NPC] Beth&f: We know that you are experimenting with &banimals &fdown here, how do you explain this tank?

&e[NPC] Jake&f: Those are my &bplushies&f! I preserve them in Jelly so they stay fresh!
&e[NPC] Jake&f: They look super realistic, but no &banimal &fwas harmed when making them!
&e[NPC] Jake&f: I can prove it! Here, take this. This is one of the &bplushies &fI made, you can have it!

&e[NPC] Jake&f: So really, I am not harming them at all!

&e[NPC] Beth&f: Everything makes sense now...I'm sorry I yelled at you Jake. I'm so sorry.

&e[NPC] Jake&f: It's alright now. I was wrong to lie about it and I should have told you sooner.

&e[NPC] Beth&f: &7<player>&f, thank you so much for telling me what you saw here. I'll be forever grateful.
&e[NPC] Beth&f: I have to go now, I hope to see you guys soon.
}}

blocks.template_raw:
{{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou finally retrieved the Sulphur.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat took you so long?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fA gian-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou even needed the help of those adventurers.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lDo you have no shame?

&e[NPC] Ugo: &fI didn't-

&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lLook at the time. You are late to your training.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7<player> &f&lI am in your debt.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son.
&e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side.

I've come this far, and I won't stop now. If you won't tell me the truth, I'll find it myself. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBeth, you don't understand, some things aren't ready to be uncovered. We have a responsibility to use this lab for good, not to bury it under layers of secrecy. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWhat's this? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fThat... is the &aCrop Analyzer&f. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fThe &aCrop Analyzer&f? What does it do? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fIt's a tool I've been developing. It analyzes &cmutations &fin crops, helps identify traits that can improve &6yield&f, &9resistance &for even &dflavor&f. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBut it's not finished. It's delicate work, Beth. Work that requires precision, and data. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fWork that shouldn't be done in isolation. Jake, this could change everything for farmers everywhere. Why are you hiding something so revolutionary? &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fBecause it's not perfect yet. A mistake could have disastrous consequences. I didn't want to involve anyone until I was sure it was ready. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fJake, you've done incredible work here. But you don't have to do it alone anymore. Let me and &7 &fhelp you. &e[NPC] Beth&f: &fTogether, we can finish this and make sure it's used responsibly. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAlright. You're right, Beth. I've been trying to carry this burden alone for too long. If we're going to make this work, we'll do it together. &e[NPC] Jake&f: &fAnd you, &7&f, you've been instrumental in getting us to this point. You should have access to the &aCrop Analyzer&f. You've earned my trust. }} |} ==Trivia == *'''Beth''' is one of the [[NPC]]s the player must talk to during the quest [[Quests#Talk to the Villager Inhabitants|Talk to the Villager Inhabitants]]. *After having '''Beth''' visit the player's [[The Garden|Garden]] {{Green|3}} times, the player can dig a block at {{Coords|175|42|-470}} in the {{zone|Glowing Mushroom Cave}} and find a hidden base. On her 4th visit, the player can go back to the base and claim {{Item|Jake's Plushie}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Dec 5|[[File: Beth.png|26px]] Added the final part to '''Beth's''' quest.}} |beta= {{History|2021/Apr 21|[[File: Beth.png|26px]] Added '''Beth'''.}} {{History|0.19.11|'''Beth''' can now visit the player's [[Garden]] more than 4 times.}} {{History|2025/Dec 15|Added the final part to '''Beth's''' quest.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

{{Quest|Recover Sulphur}} |abiphone = Yes |location = [[Mage Council]] |location_page_description = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to discuss stolen research. |x = -121.5 |y = 82 |z = -756.5 |location2 = [[Burning Desert]] |location_page_description2 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to find the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x2 = -526.5 |y2 = 86 |z2 = -885.5 |location3 = [[Crimson Isle]] |location_page_description3 = Appears here during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] next to the lost [[Apprentice (Crimson Isle)|Apprentice]]. |x3 = -522.86 |y3 = 104 |z3 = -918.8 |minimap_location3 = Burning Desert |location4 = The Wasteland |location_page_description4 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]]. |x4 = -373.5 |y4 = 117 |z4 = -977.5 |location5 = Forgotten Skull |location_page_description5 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] after defeating [[Kuudra]]. |x5 = -373.5 |y5 = 113 |z5 = -1036.5 }} '''Captain Ahone''' is an [[NPC]] found throughout the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} primarily during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]], as well as at the end of both [[Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questlines]]. == Quest == '''Captain Ahone''' first appears during the [[Mage Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] when the player is sent to the {{Zone|Mage Council}} to meet about stolen research. Later in the quest, he appears in the {{Zone|Burning Desert}} with a {{Item|Small Backpack}}, after {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with finding the lost {{NPCSprite|Apprentice (Crimson Isle);Apprentice}}. Their [[Abiphone]] contact gets added to the player's Abiphone, instructing them to call upon finding the Apprentice. When this happens, he then walks up to the Apprentice with {{NPCSprite|Grelius}} and {{NPCSprite|Krevius}}, splashes him with healing potions, and then disappears, tasking the player player with reporting back to {{NPCSprite|Dean}}. Towards the end of the quest, {{NPCSprite|Dean}} tasks the player with calling Captain Ahone, who then instructs the player to meet them by the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}. He can then be found there with several other [[NPCs]], who all agree to investigate [[Kuudra]]. This ending also occurs at the end of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. After defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time as part of either quest, they then appear in the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}} with {{NPCSprite|Ugo}} and {{NPCSprite|Elle}}, disappearing after you continue the quest. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Dialogue |- | class="ct" | During the {{Zone|Mage Council}} meeting | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: Oh, &7 &fis here! They're the one who retrieved the research! &e[NPC] &d&lQueen Nyx&f: I see, we owe you adventurer, this object is of great value to us. &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: Yes indeed! With it we are able to extract salt from Netherrack, it will be a massive asset when cooking. &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: You see, while we evolved past the need for crops and cattle, the quality of our food remains low. &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: I would say close to 50% of our research is still spent on food artifacts and machines. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: And once again those Piglins stole our research. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: They believe we are working on war engines. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: The tension is rising and soon we might have to cross swords with them. &e[NPC] &d&lQueen Nyx&f: Captain Ahone, this isn't a conversation we should have right now. &e[NPC] &d&lQueen Nyx&f: Thank you very much, &7&f. Would you mind leaving us now, we have matters to discuss. &e[NPC] &5Dean&f: &7 &fplease meet me back at the Academy, we have a lot to talk about! }} |- | class="ct" | In the {{Zone|Mage Council}}, after the meeting | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Our relations with the Piglins is getting worse, things are spiraling out of control.}} |- | class="ct" | First Interaction in the {{Zone|Burning Desert}}
{{DG|After Being Sent by {{NPCSprite|Dean}}}} | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: You are looking for the Dean's Apprentice? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I'm afraid he might be in great danger, I just found his backpack and there is some &cblood &fon it... &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: We must find him at once, I really hope this isn't the Piglin's doing. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Let's separate. Take my &acontact &fand call me if you find anything. &b✆ &5Captain Ahone &fhas been added to your Abiphone's contacts!}} |- | class="ct" | Looking for the {{NPCSprite|Apprentice (Crimson Isle);Apprentice}} | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: He might be nearby, let me know if you find anything.}} |- | class="ct" | Calling with an [[Abiphone]]
{{DG|After Finding Apprentice}} | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &b✆ &fYou found the Apprentice? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &b✆ &fGood work. We will come to you at once! }} |- | class="ct" | After Help Arrives | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Looks like we found him just in time, he will live, but he needs medical attention. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I know the Dean's Apprentice, they would never take that much damage from the monsters around here. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Once they wake up from their coma we will know what happened to them, but I have my suspicions. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: The guards and I will bring him back to the city, please explain the situation to the Dean.}} |- | class="ct" | After giving {{NPCSprite|Dean}} his resources
(Can appear as [[Abiphone]] dialogue) | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &7&f! Perfect timing &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &fOur entire stash of Sulphur got stolen. I have no idea how "they" did it. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &fThe Queen is warning me against hasty conclusions, but enough is enough. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &fWe cannot let the Barbarians trespass our borders without retaliation. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &fMy scouts told me they sighted Barbarian activities in the &cNorth, near the Forgotten Skull&f. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &fLet's meet again there, and be prepared for combat.}} |- | rowspan="2" class="ct" | Before heading to the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}
(Can appear as [[Abiphone]] dialogue) | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &fThe Forgotten Skull in the North is close to the Barbarian borders, they are probably hiding the stolen Sulphur there.}} |- | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &fSome matters cannot be solved peacefully.}} |- | class="ct" | During {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}} Meeting |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life! &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside. }} |- | class="ct" | After defeating [[Kuudra]] | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You too &7&f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Is anyone going to thank me? }} |- | class="ct" | Calling with an [[Abiphone]]
{{DG|After defeating [[Kuudra]] and then speaking to [[Dean]]}} | {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &b✆ &fThank you for helping with the tentacle monster. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &b✆ &fWe owe the Piglins an apology. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: &b✆ &fI will stay in Scarleton and prepare for the next battle! }} |} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Captain Ahone.png|26px]] Added '''Captain Ahone'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Captain Ahone.png|26px]] Added '''Captain Ahone'''.}} {{history|0.19.3|Added a dialogue to Captain Ahone's [[Abiphone]] when his quest is completed.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}

[[File:Cult of the Fallen Star Screenshot.png|thumb|290x290px|The cult in the game]]
The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is a secret cult found in the {{zone|Cliffside Veins}} in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} at {{Coordinates|-45|193|45}}. To find the cult, players need to arrive between 0 AM and 6 AM in-game time on either the 7th, 14th, 21st or 28th day of each SkyBlock month. The entrance to the cult's cave is at {{Coordinates|-26|198|40}}. After going to a meeting, the player will obtain the {{ach|The Cult of the Fallen Star|ach=true}}.

After speaking to {{NPCSprite|Brarnas}} for the first time, players will be given the [[Fallen Star Helmet]]. In subsequent meetings with the cult, when the player wears the [[Fallen Star Helmet]], they will receive {{Item|Starfall|amount=200}}.

[[Silnar]] is also a member of the '''Cult''', who gives the player a [[Fallen Star Lozenge]].

== Location ==
The cult's cave is located in a hidden area of {{Zone|Cliffside Veins}}; specifically, it is west of the purple crystal and up the cliff. Players can use the lava channel in the {{Zone|Lava Springs}} to access the location without having to use ender pearls.

== Trivia ==
*Meetings, except for the gap between the meetings on the 28th and the 7th, are 7 in-game days apart (2 hours and 20 minutes in real life time).
*'''Dalir''' is the only cult member players can interact with.
*Despite the message saying "come back next time" if you forget to wear the helmet, you can simply put on the helmet and then talk to Brarnas again to receive the {{Item|Starfall}}.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is likely the antithesis to the [[Armor of the Rising Sun|Rising Sun]] as they share the same naming scheme.
*There is a [[Fairy Soul]] at {{Coords|-52|205|48}}, which is accessed from their room.
*'''Thondin''' states that his favourite food is blue pizza during cult meeting #6.
**The red and blue pizzas are a reference to [[w:The Matrix|The Matrix]]'s red pill and blue pill, where the red pill represents learning an unsettling truth, and the blue pill represents remaining in comfortable ignorance.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' members are one of 5 [[NPC]]'s to mention the "simulation" or the simulated state of the world of skyblock. Others include the [[Royal Resident]], [[Oen]], [[Yoshua]], and [[Skylark]].

To access her associated features, players must be at least {{SkyBlock Level|3}}. == Usage == {{Main|City Projects|Fire Sales|Account & Profile Upgrades|Booster Cookie|Bits}} '''Elizabeth''' has many different features in her menu, such as the option to see the most recent and all past [[City Projects]] and [[Fire Sales]]. Another feature is the [[Account & Profile Upgrades]] menu, where players can get bonuses for them on all of their [[profiles]], such as more {{Stat|MF}} and [[Ender Chest]] pages. The player can also get bonuses for all their co-op members on one profile, some for free (like [[Minion|Minion Slots]], some costing {{Gems}} such as [[Co-op|Co-op slots]]. Another menu allows players to receive {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=1}} for free and then purchase additional ones for {{Gems}}. The user can buy {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=1}} for {{Gems|325}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=6}}s for {{Gems|1950}}, or {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=12}}s for {{Gems|3900}}. In her menu is also located the Bits Shop, where players can use {{Bits}}, obtained using {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, to purchase various items. Most notably, the player can buy a {{Item|God Potion}} for {{Bits|1500}}, a {{Item|Kismet Feather}} for {{Bits|1350}}, {{Item|Pure Black Dye}} and {{Item|Pure White Dye}} for {{Bits|250000}}, and [[Enrichments]] for {{Bits|5000}} Her last menu lists the 5 commonly available [[Ranks]] on Hypixel and their perks: {{Rank|VIP}}, {{Rank|VIP+}}, {{Rank|MVP}}, {{Rank|MVP+}}, and {{Rank|MVP++}}. Furthermore, there is an item at the bottom of this page, as well as other pages, displaying your current {{Gems}}, {{Bits}}, and [[Fame Ranks|Fame Rank]]. After completing {{NPCSprite|Brigette}}'s account security quest, she gives the player a free {{Item|Booster Cookie}}. == Interface == {{Outdated|section=yes}} {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Below SkyBlock Level 3 |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dElizabeth&f: Hello! I hope you enjoy using it! }} |} == Account and Profile Upgrades == {{Outdated|{{Changelog|2026/April 8}} Changes to Skyblock Gem bundles resulting in an increase of cost}} These upgrades can be applied to either your current profile or your entire account. To fully upgrade everything to the maximum level, a player will need '''6,050 SkyBlock Gems'''. The total waiting time is '''382 real-world days''' for profile upgrades and '''244 days''' for account upgrades. You can choose to spend an additional '''80,904 SkyBlock Gems''' to skip the waiting period entirely. The cost will depend on the current value of SkyBlock Gems. ==== Upgrades per tier of gems bought: ==== {| class="wikitable" !Option !Bundle !Bundle Price !Gems per Pack !Packs Needed !Total Gems !Total Cost |- |1 |700 |$7.49 |93.46 gems/$ |9 |6,300 |'''$67.41''' |- |2 |1,800 |$18.74 |96.05 gems/$ |4 |7200 |'''$73.96''' |- |3 |3,750 |$37.49 |100.03 gems/$ |2 |7,500 |'''$74.98''' |- |4 |7,600 |$74.99 |101.35 gems/$ |1 |7,600 |'''$74.99''' |- |5 |17,000 |$149.99 |113.34 gems/$ |1 |17,000 |'''$149.99''' |} The best option is to buy 3 '''× 1,800 packs + 1 × 700 pack''' for a total of '''6,100 Gems''' at a cost of '''$61,67''' — but only if you plan to upgrade without skipping the waiting time. ==== Skipping time per tier of gems bought: ==== {| class="wikitable" !Option !Bundle !Bundle Price !Gems per Pack !Packs Needed !Total Gems !Total Cost |- |1 |700 |$7.25 |96.55 gems/$ |116 |81,200 |'''$841.00''' |- |2 |1,800 |$18.14 |99.23 gems/$ |45 |81,000 |'''$816.30''' |- |3 |3,750 |$36,29 |103.33 gems/$ |22 |82,500 |'''$798.38''' |- |4 |7,600 |$72.59 |104.70 gems/$ |11 |83,600 |'''$798.49''' |- |5 |17,000 |$145.19 |117.09 gems/$ |5 |85,000 |'''$725.95''' |} '''The best option''', '''considering''' you need the previous gems to upgrade and skip the waiting time, is to buy: 4 '''× 17,000 packs + 1 × 7,600 pack + 1 × 3,750 pack + 1 × 1,800 pack for a total of 6,300 Gems''' at a cost of '''$707.78'''. == Trivia == *The patch notes for the [https://hypixel.net/threads/5692280/ Better Mayors update] claim that "'''Elizabeth''' was too stubborn to move, so she is staying at the same location". Despite this claim, she actually moved 4 blocks. *On the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]], the Community Shop requires {{SBL|10}} instead of {{SBL|3}}. *When '''Elizabeth''' says "That's rough, buddy." during the Security Safety Quest; it appears to be a reference to Prince Zuko from ATLA. == Gallery == Elizabeth Scene.png|'''Elizabeth''' as seen in the Community Center. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jan 30|Moved '''Elizabeth''' from {{Coords|-3.5|72|-101.5}} to {{Coords|-6.25|79|19.25}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} {{History|2026/March 23|Abiphone Contact reworked - no longer requires [[Abiphone Contacts Trio]] and enables being called whenever Account & Profile Upgrade finishes or a FIRE Sale starts.}} |beta= {{History|0.9|[[File:Elizabeth.png|26px]] Added '''Elizabeth'''.}} {{History|0.15|Changed '''Elizabeth'''{{'}}s dialogue from saying to go to the {{zone|Deep Caverns}} to talking about [[SkyBlock Levels]] if the player doesn't have access to the shop.}} {{History|0.16|Added [[Abiphones#Contacts|{{Aqua|Abiphone Contact}}]].}} {{History|2023/June 21|Fixed the city project button being empty when calling '''Elizabeth''' through an [[Abiphone]].}} {{history|0.19.1|Fixed Community Shop profile upgrade history not displaying the right player names.}} {{History|0.24.2|Moved '''Elizabeth''' from {{Coords|-3.5|72|-101.5}} to {{Coords|-6.25|79|19.25}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} {{History|0.24.3|Abiphone Contact reworked - no longer requires [[Abiphone Contacts Trio]] and enables being called whenever Account & Profile Upgrade finishes or a FIRE Sale starts.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

She acts as a guide, and helps explain the new systems, factions and mobs there. == Quests == '''Elle''' is one of the main [[NPCs]] for the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] for both [[Factions]]. She first appears in the {{Zone|Stronghold}} trying to fight three {{MobSprite|Blaze (Elle's Quest);Blazes}}, after which she tasks the player with bringing her {{Item|Magma Chunk|amount=4}}, {{Item|Blaze Ashes|amount=3}} and {{Item|Spectre Dust|amount=2}}. She will then task the player with speaking to four [[NPCs]] from each [[Faction]], so that they can make their mind up about which one they want to join. '''Grandpa Wolf''' is an [[NPC]] located in {{Zone|Grandpa Wolf's Cave}} within the {{Zone|Glacite Tunnels}}. He unlocks access to [[Frozen Corpses|Frozen Corpse Milestones]].

&eSelect an option: &a[Yes] &c[No]

&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Okay, now I'm familiar with your &ascent&f!

&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: You know, you're starting to look kinda &f&otasty&f...

&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Great, the look on your face had me worried for a second!
&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Anyways, whenever you loot a &bFrozen Corpse&f, I'll come soon after to retrieve it.

&e[NPC] &6Grandpa Wolf&f: Though they're not very talkative fellows on account of being dead 'n all, you can still have a rummage through their backpacks for some loot!

{{/UI}}

== Tips ==
*Players can use {{code|/viewfrozencorpsemilestones}} to access the milestone menu remotely.
*Players should unlock and max [[Heart_of_the_Mountain#Tier_10|Gifts from the Departed perk]] in [[Heart of the Mountain]] before progressing this milestone.

== Trivia ==
*The total cost of keys for maxed Frozen Corpse milestone is {{BZC|100 Umber Key|100 Tungsten Key|20 Skeleton Key}}.
* '''Grandpa Wolf''' is likely related to {{NPCSprite|Grandma Wolf}}.
**Both of them start their dialogue by introducing their respective conundrums to the player.
*The [[German Wolf Skin]] uses the same head as '''Grandpa Wolf'''.
*The {{Code|/viewfrozencorpsemilestones}} command can be used even without access to the {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}}.

I'll add you now. &e[NPC] &eJake&f: &b✆ &fBut don't call me after 8pm, please. }} |} == Tips == * Players can use [[Lead]]s, {{potN|Jump Boost Potion}}s, or [[Grappling Hook]]s to quickly climb up the mountain with an animal. ** The most consistent method is to use a [[Huntaxes|Huntaxe]] and [[Black Holes|Black Hole]]. Due to animals not having shards, they will float permanently into the black hole. You can move the black hole towards the mountain, taking as many animals as you wish at once. Move the black hole repeatedly until the animals levitate on top of the hut's roof. ** The classic method is to combine a lead with [[Spider's Boots]] or [[Tarantula Boots]] and double-jump to the very top. The animal will only take damage based on the distance from its highest point to the elevation of the spot it lands on, so it will take minimal damage only once when it lands on top of the mountain. The mana cost of these abilities can be reduced with a {{Item|Sheep Pet}} or {{Item|Tarantula Pet}}. ** Another method, although more difficult and expensive, is to use Spirit Boots to fly up the mountain. The boots will get you up the mountain in 2 flights because flights are very short. ** In order to get a Cow or Pig, it's recommended to land in the oasis to reset the potential fall damage before going up the mountain. *The Loch Emperor is not consumed from the summoning item after talking to Jake, meaning the player can unlock the Golden Ball item an infinite amount of times as long as they have the summon. == Gallery == File:Jake (Underground Lab).png|'''Jake''' while in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Crop Analyzer (Area).png|Crop Analyzer and '''Jake''' in the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} File:Jake's House (Render).png|[[Jake's House]] on top of the mountain == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Dec 10|link=none|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|2026/July 15|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} {{History|2026/Oct 15|Moved '''Jake''' and his house from {{Coords|261.5|184|-565.5}} to {{Coords|245.5|95|-344.5}}.}} |beta= {{History|2021/April 21|[[File:Jake.png|26px]] Added '''Jake'''.}} {{History|2025/Dec 15|Added Abiphone contact.}} {{History|0.26.1|Updated the animal axes sold by '''Jake''' to Advanced Animal Axes and added the corresponding Basic Animal Axes to their shop costs.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

{{Infobox/Character |shop = Yes |location=[[Archery Range]] |location_page_description = Sells higher-tier [[Arrows]]. |x=-40.5 |y=69 |z=-92.5 }} '''Jax''' is an [[NPC]] located near the {{zone|Archery Range}} in the {{zone|Village}} who sells arrow-related items to the player. == Quest == After first talking to '''Jax''', the player can go in the room to his left and start a shooting quest. The player must remain on the elevated pressure plate the entire time whilst shooting at the {{Item|Redstone Lamp|link=}}s around the room.
After completing the first quest, the player will gain access to Jax's shop. After that, the time to complete a round of shooting all the targets gets shorter, but allows players to purchase better [[Arrows]] from Jax's shop.
After completing all 3 quests, Practice Mode will be unlocked, which tests how fast the [[player]] can shoot all targets. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Quest
Number ! Time to
complete |- | 1 | 25 seconds |- | 2 | 15 seconds |- | 3 | 12 seconds |- | 4 |11 seconds |} If the player triggers the 4th round, by interacting with '''Jax''' with an [[Abiphone]] and shoots all targets under {{Green|11s}}, they can obtain '''Jax''''s Abiphone contact. If they can't do it in that time, they will have to pay {{c|10m}} for it. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition !Guranteed Dialogue |- | colspan="2" class="ct" | First Interaction |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Jax&f: Hello &7[player]&f! {{Infobox/Character |quests = {{Quest|One Man's Trash}} |shop = Yes |abiphone = Yes |location = [[Backwater Bayou]] |location_page_description = Introduces the player to the {{Item|Junk Sinker}} and sells items for junk. |x = 6.5 |y = 72 |z = 4.5 }} '''Junker Joel''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Backwater Bayou}} that introduces the {{Item|Junk Sinker}} and trades junk. == Shop == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !colspan="2" |Condition !Dialogue |- |class="ct" colspan="2" |First Interaction |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &2Junker Joel&f: &fYou alright there, my friend? &e[NPC] &2Junker Joel&f: &fI don't see many people 'round these parts. == Usage ==
=== Unlocking More Powers ===
{{Main|Accessory Powers}}
More advanced powers can be unlocked by giving Maxwell {{Green|9x}} [[Power Stones]] of the same type.

=== Stats Tuning ===
Maxwell allows the player to tune the stats they want, so that they can optimize their setup to their liking. The stats that can be tuned are:
*{{stat|hp}}
*{{stat|def}}
*{{stat|spd}}
*{{stat|str}}
*{{stat|crit dmg}}
*{{stat|crit chance}}
*{{stat|Attack Speed}}
*{{stat|int}}

Every 10 [[Accessory Power]] grants {{yellow|1 Tuning Point}}. Tuning Points are used to tune a specific stat to increase it. The player can remove Tuning Points from stats if they want to, in case they want to invest them in another stat. The player is offered tuning templates, in which the player can save and load their stats. First template is free, the others cost {{bits|10,000}} to unlock each.

== Tips ==
*You can hold right click instead of continually clicking the NPC to keep the dialogue going.
** Once he starts counting down, there is no need to click or hold mouse buttons anymore.
** The countdown will continue when you rejoin the Dwarven mines.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Royal Resident''' is one of the few NPCs that break the [[w:Fourth wall|fourth wall]], a term used to describe a character separated from its audience, due to it being in a "different world".  
**This is because it is aware that it's on a server and that servers restart.
*Its countdown takes roughly 25,000 seconds, or around 7 hours to complete.
*Despite the reference to server restarts, the player can leave the lobby anytime after the Royal Resident starts counting down from 5,000 and will continue the countdown when the player returns.
*At line 79 it transforms into a cow, and at line 94 into a sheep, followed by revealing that he has no name at line 130.
*21 lines after becoming "No Name", it will give the player {{Item|The Cake}}.
*{{Item|The Cake}} is a reference to the game ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal_(video_game)  Portal]''. 
**It takes around 15–20 minutes to obtain {{Item|The Cake}}.
*"Because of you and those meddling kids..." is a reference to a popular children's show, [[w:Scooby Doo|''Scooby Doo'']].
*At the end of the conversation, the {{ach|Royal Conversation|ach=true}} is rewarded to the player.

== Trivia ==
*'''Sun Gecko''' most likely is a reference to [[fandom:Dragonball:Son Goku|Son Goku]] from the Dragon Ball franchise.
** '''Sun Gecko''' could also reference the historic Chinese military strategist, [[w:Sun_Tzu|Sun Tzu]].
*Beating '''Sun Gecko''' for the first time rewards the [[Achievements|"If you wish to defeat me..."]] Achievement.
** This achievement most likely originates from a phrase from Technoblade's video "''Skeppy vs Technoblade: The Final Reckoning''".
*Beating '''Sun Gecko''' with all {{Green|7}} Time Chamber Modifiers rewards the [[Achievements|Maximum Power]] Achievement.
*{{Item|Extremely Real Shuriken}}s can be used as a substitute for {{Item|Time Shuriken}}s to keep up the player's combo.

&e[NPC] &cUdel: &7&oNo, I'm in the middle of my keynote! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &7&oYes, I'll call you back. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAhem. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSorry about that, I forgot to put my Abiphone on vibrate. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAnyways, I am proud to present: &e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lABIPHONE FLIP &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThis stunning new model has a brand-new speaker system. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAllowing you to choose a ringtone from our built-in selection! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThrough sheer determination, I have also managed to find enough space for 1 extra contact! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eTo satisfy my shareholders, I had to double the price of this new Abiphone. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eTo satisfy my customers, I am giving everyone &a50% off&e on their new Abiphone purchase! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThis way, everyone is happy! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eYou can trade in your old &5Abiphone XIV&e for an even bigger discount! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe future of Abiphones is TODAY! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe &6Abiphone Flip&e is now for sale!}} |- | class="ct" | [[Abiphone|Abiphone Flip+]] Announcement |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHello customers! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eI am so glad you could make it to my keynote! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eFirst, I would like to apologize for this one being a &e&olittle later ðan usual. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThere is an ongoing lawsuit between myself and a [[Abiphones & Co.|counterfeit Abiphone]], which has been taking up most of my time. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eHowever, I am here, and so are you, so let's begin! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &e... &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAhem. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSince my previous keynote, my minions and I have been even harder at work trying to find something even more innovative than the &6Abiphone Flip&e. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eWe thought and thought and then thought some more before I, and only I, had an &oincredible breakthrough&e. &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eWhat if our latest model could save you, like, a second, whenever you wanted to call someone? &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAfter all, less downtime for my clientele means I get more uptime on my all-inclusive holidays! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSo, without further ado, I am proud to present: &e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lABIPHONE FLIP &e[NPC] &cUdel: &c&lPLUS! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe most cutting edge technology around today, this new model comes with the &bSpeed Dial &efeature! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThis allows you to call your favorite contact with just a single click! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eAlso, in my infinite generosity, I have given this model an &aadditional contact slot&e! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThat's all for this year. &bUdel's Abiphone Services &eappreciate your continued support during the ongoing lawsuit! &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eSo, without further ado... &e[NPC] &cUdel: &eThe &6Abiphone Flip+ &eis now for sale! }} |} == Trivia == *'''Udel''' used to sell [[Abiphones]] for {{Green|1.5%}} less than their original prices. *'''Udel''' is {{NPCSprite|Dean}}'s cousin. *According to {{NPCSprite|Karis}}, '''Udel''' created the Abiphone but forgot to patent it. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{history|2022/March 8|[[File:Udel.png|26px]] Added '''Udel'''.}} {{History|2025/Aug 28| Removed {{Green|98.5%}} price multiplier from '''Udel'''.| Revamped the shop, and moved Udel one block from {{Coords|-78.5|107|-788.5}} to {{Coords|-78.5|108|-787.5}}. }} |beta= {{history|0.13|[[File:Udel.png|26px]] Added '''Udel'''.}} {{history|2022/Sep 7|link=none|{{Aqua|Udel's Abiphone Keynote}} event occurs.|Added new [[Abiphone|Abiphones]] to '''Udel''''s shop.}} {{History|0.23.4| Removed {{Green|98.5%}} price multiplier from '''Udel'''.| Revamped the shop, and moved Udel one block from {{Coords|-78.5|107|-788.5}} to {{Coords|-78.5|108|-787.5}}. }} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}

{{Quest|Recover Sulphur}} |location = [[Crimson Isle]] |minimap_location = Burning Desert |location_page_description = Appears here at the start of the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]]. |x = -508.5 |y = 98 |z = -633.5 |location2 = [[Chief's Hut]] |location_page_description2 = Appears here during the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] to speak to {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}}. |x2 = -587.5 |y2 = 115 |z2 = -688.5 |location3 = [[Dragontail]] |location_page_description3 = Appears here during the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] after being kicked out of the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}}. |x3 = -612.5 |y3 = 107 |z3 = -688.5 |location4 = [[Dragontail]] |location_page_description4 = Appears here during the [[Barbarian Faction]] [[Crimson Isle Main Questline|Questline]] for the player to complete tasks for them. |x4 = -581.5 |y4 = 100 |z4 = -684.5 |location5 = [[The Wasteland]] |location_page_description5 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]]. |x5 = -369.5 |y5 = 117 |z5 = -977.5 |location6 = [[Forgotten Skull]] |location_page_description6 = Appears here at the end of the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] after defeating {{MobSprite|Kuudra}}. |x6 = -370.5 |y6 = 113 |z6 = -1036.5 }} '''Ugo''' is an [[NPC]] found in {{zone|Dragontail}}. They are [[Chief Scorn]]'s son and a key figure in the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline#Barbarian|Barbarian Faction questline]]. == Quest == '''Ugo''' is found by the player and [[Elle]] in a little cave in the {{zone|Burning Desert}} in the form of a pig. The player must feed them {{Item|Sulphur|amount=1}} and escort Ugo and [[Elle]] to the {{zone|Chief's Hut}}. Doing so will accept the player into the [[Barbarian Faction]]. '''Ugo''' and [[Elle]] will then ask the player to steal the Research from the {{NPCSprite|Dean}} in the {{zone|Cathedral}}. After successfully doing so, the player will gain {{Reputation|Barbarian|+100}}, and Ugo will ask the player to complete a Test of Force, a Test of Stamina and a Test of Mastery, with a minimum rating of {{Yellow|C}}. Finally, '''Ugo''' will ask the player to kill a {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} and a {{MobSprite|Magma Cube Boss}}. Doing so will grant {{Reputation|Barbarian|+150}}, plus an additional 20 for killing the boss the first time that day. The player will meet '''Ugo''' again after they complete [[Gris]]'s Quest, where they will meet Ugo, Elle and [[Captain Ahone]] outside the {{zone|Forgotten Skull}} to defeat [[Kuudra]]. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable centertext" !Condition !Dialogue |- | Start of the [[Barbarian Faction]] quest
(As a [[Pig]]) |style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You handled that quite well. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: &2Corrupted Monsters &frarely appear on the island, it usually means they consumed too much &2Sulphur&f. &e[NPC] &d&k----&f: Oink &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Did you hear that? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I think it was coming from here! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Let's go. }} |- | Before being given [[Sulphur]]
(As a [[Pig]]) |style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &d&k----&f: Oink}} |- | Talking to '''Ugo''' after giving [[Sulphur]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You saved me! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Memory is failing me but I think I remember getting attacked. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My leg got hurt and I had to hide here, the rest is blurry... &e[NPC] &cElle&f: How could you leave &cDragontail &fwithout &2Sulphur &fon you! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I know, I was careless, I was on a mission for... &e[NPC] Ugo&f: SULPHUR! My father is going to KILL ME!! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Let's not exaggerate. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You don't understand, my father is the &cChief&f! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were not exaggerating. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Please help me, I have to present myself to him. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Of course. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I will shoulder you to the &cChief's Hut&f. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: &7&f make sure monsters don't attack us on the way there. }} |- |Whilst {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}} Scolds '''Ugo''' |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, where have you been? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou had ONE job! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&l3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Well- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAnd you two, what are your names? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I'm- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThank you for saving my rascal of a son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAre you looking to join our ranks? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: No but- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lPerfect! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lIf you betray us you'll die. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I can't- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lEnough talking! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, go back out there and finish the job! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort them out of my Hut! }} |- | After being kicked out of the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My leg really hurts. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: It was already quite bad before this fall but now... &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Your father sure has some character. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: He's not that bad, you get used to it. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I don't know what he wants you to do out there, but we can't let you go back there with your injured leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'm afraid I have to. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Just tell us what you have to do and we'll do it for you. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I can't tell you it's highly confidential. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I don't care, you can't go back out there with a broken leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: &f&oSigh &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My father believes that the &cMage Faction &fis working on some kind of powerful &2war instrument. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We know they are hiding something inside their &cCathedral&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My job is to infiltrate their &cCathedral &fand steal their &2war machine &fso we can study it. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Say no more, that's a perfect job for &7&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Why them? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Alright let's go. }} |- | rowspan="2" | Before stealing the research | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Did you even agree to do this?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Thanks for helping out, and good luck!}} |- | After stealing the research | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: You actually did it, I can't thank you enough! &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: Let's show it to my father. &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: Oh and hum... &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: Please don't mention that I didn't get it myself. }} |- | Presenting the research | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo why are you limping? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My le- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHave you found the evil wizard machine? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Y- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGive it to the guards, we will investigate it. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lEnough with the mages and their shenanigans. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Alri- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &lThe Town Board is filling up and &lyou are late on your Training Ugo. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat have you been doing? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHurry up, failure isn't an option. }} |- | After presenting research | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Ugh &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I completely forgot about my Training. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I have to go to the Town Board. }} |- | rowspan="7" | When the player is too slow when following Ugo | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'm right here, don't get lost.}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Hey are you following?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: What's taking so long?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Did you get lost?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Are you a snail?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Hello}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Get a move on.}} |- |First interaction at the town board |style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: This is our &cTown Board&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Whenever someone needs something they put a request here and anyone can fulfill it. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Not enough people are doing them so I usually have to do most requests myself. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: There are also &cDojo&f requests, those are my training sessions... &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I don't think I can do my training with my bad leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: &cMaster Tao&f has terrible sight, maybe you could go to the &cDojo&f and pretend to be me? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll wait for you here. }} |- |Before completing the [[Dojo]] tasks |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: The &cDojo&f is on the opposite side of the island, south of &5Scarleton&f, the Mage city.}} |- |After completing the [[Dojo]] tasks |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: How was the training? Not too bad? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'm sorry you had to go through this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My father wants me to become the next Chief one day. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I don't really have a choice. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The &cTown Board &fmissions get harder the higher your Reputation gets. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: If that's fine with you, I'll give you a couple of my missions, but they are quite tough. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The first one requires eliminating a &cMage Outlaw&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: They are technically Mages, but not part of the Mage Faction, they constantly cause problems. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The one we need to eliminate is in the &cCourtyard&f, it's on the outskirts of &5Scarleton&f, towards the north. }} |- | rowspan="2" | Before killing the {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Mage Outlaws often attack Piglins, the Wizards don't really want to deal with them so we have to do it ourself.}} |- |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: The Courtyard is a bit hidden, it is north-west of &5Scarleton&f, just outside of the city.}} |- | After killing the {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You dealt with it? Great! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You are quite competent, those Mages are usually quite strong, they also think very highly of themselves. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The next mission is to kill the &cMagma Boss&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: He's an overgrown Magma Cube that keeps on growing infinitely. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We have to defeat him every few weeks to keep it in check, otherwise it can grow out of control. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: It's very easy to find the &cMagma Boss&f, simply take any of the &7tunnels below the Volcano &fand descend until you reach the center. }} |- | rowspan="2" | Before killing the {{MobSprite|Magma Boss}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Don't feel too bad about killing those Magma Cubes, they will be born again.}} |- |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Once you find the large room below the Volcano, you'll be able to see it.}} |- | After killing the {{MobSprite|Magma Boss}} | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I am glad you are back. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You completed all my missions, I am very grateful. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Now if you will excuse me, it's time for me to take care of my leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: See you around &7&f. }} |- |Before meeting at the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}
(tasks completed) |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Time to focus on myself.}} |- |Meeting outside the {{zone|Forgotten Skull}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life! &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside. }} |- | class="ct" | Right after defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You too &7&f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Is anyone going to thank me? }} |- | Speaking to {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}} after defeating [[Kuudra]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou finally retrieved the Sulphur. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat took you so long? &e[NPC] Ugo: &fA gian- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou even needed the help of those adventurers. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lDo you have no shame? &e[NPC] Ugo: &fI didn't- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lLook at the time. You are late to your training. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7 &f&lI am in your debt. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI won't hold you any longer. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGood luck in your adventures. }} |} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Ugo.png|26px]] Added '''Ugo'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Ugo.png|26px]] Added '''Ugo'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}

'''Vincent''' is an [[NPC]] in the {{zone|Artist's Abode}}. He serves as a guide to the [[Dye]] system, which was improved upon with his release.

== Mechanics ==
=== Dye Drop Chance Boost ===
On every [[Time Systems#SkyBlock_Time|SkyBlock Year]], 3 [[Dyes]] are randomly chosen by '''Vincent'''. Out of these, 2 have their drop chances {{Green|doubled}}, while the 3rd one has its drop chances {{Green|tripled}} during that year.

The current year's chosen Dyes can be seen in '''Vincent's''' interface.

=== Donating Dyes ===
A [[Player]] can donate any non-animated [[Dye]] via '''Vincent's''' menu, thus converting it into a [[Bucket of Dye]] accessory of a matching color.

=== Garden ===
'''Vincent''' can appear as a [[The Garden#Visitor|Visitor]] on {{zone|The Garden}} once the player reaches {{Garden|14}} and donated a [[Dye]] to '''Vincent'''. '''Vincent''' requests {{Item|Sunflower}}s and has a {{Chance|0.04%|1|2500}} to award a {{Item|Wild Strawberry Dye}}.

== Trivia ==
*He explicitly mentions {{NPCSprite|Marco}} and {{NPCSprite|Pablo}} implying their fame.
*''''Vincent''' is based on the 19th-century Dutch painter [[w:Vincent van Gogh|Vincent van Gogh]], who is renowned worldwide for his works.
**Similarly to his real life counterpart, '''Vincent''' is missing his left ear.
*'''Vincent''' was added to the [[SkyBlock Prototype|main server]] on the birthday of [[w:Andy Warhol|Andy Warhol]], another famous artist, known particularly for his pop art.
*'''Vincent''' asking for {{Item|Sunflower}} while visiting {{zone|The Garden}} is a reference to two series of still life paintings titled [[w:Sunflowers (Van Gogh series)|Sunflowers]].
*After giving '''Vincent''' a {{Item|Mole Pet}} for his [[Abiphone]] Contact, a {{Level|53}} {{Item|Mole Pet}} will be seen floating next to him.
**Although the maximum rarity of a pet is {{Mythic}}, the pet's text color matches {{aqua|Vincent}}, but it may imply it is somehow {{Divine}}.
**The level of '''Vincent's''' {{Level|53}} {{Item|Mole Pet}}, a reference to [[w:Vincent van Gogh|Vincent van Gogh]] being born in 1853.
*{{Gamemode|Ironman}} players can only donate dyes that they have obtained themselves, and not ones purchased from the [[Auction House]]. This is tracked on a per-item basis, regardless of whether they have already obtained another copy of the same dye themselves.
